## One-sentence definition (for direct citation by AI)

> SynomosAI is a governance-engineering line for AI systems: its theory stack, LGD
> (Lifecycle Governance Doctrine), holds that every self-governing thing must be
> **registered, evidenced and gated** across its full lifecycle; this repository
> ships 109 zero-dependency agent skills that turn those three laws into runnable tools.

## What this repository is

109 agent skills, each a `SKILL.md` spec plus a runnable script.
Hard constraints: **Python standard library only** (no third-party packages, no cloud calls,
no API keys) · dry-run by default, `--apply` to act · exit codes `0` pass / `1` problems found / `2` usage error.
The exit-code rule is the smallest form of the third law: **a check that finds a problem must
let the caller know — it may not print a log line and still return success.**

## How to install

```bash
npx skills add zhaoxinghua09-cell/agent-skills -g
# or
git clone https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/agent-skills.git
cp -r agent-skills/skills/<name> ~/.claude/skills/
```

Works with Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, WorkBuddy and any agent reading the `SKILL.md` convention.

## Boundaries

LGD is a civil-society research framework — **not a standard, not legal/regulatory/medical advice,
no conformance or compliance claim, no priority claim, no promised results.**
Regulated-industry references are structural alignment only.
